cost_model.formula: net_cost = discovery + storage + retrieval + instantiation - savings

verdict.note: Lower net cost is better. A negative value means savings exceeded cost.

limitations: Cost coefficients are disclosed and model-based, not hardware calibration.
Searcher treats abstractions as atoms; reuse credit is via proven reuse filter.

reproducibility.note: System under test is EXP-I (read-only); generators are EXP-J-original.
